detail.body:
# What does this PR do ?

Draft native Transformers 5.19 support for Nemotron 3.5 Super VL conversion, preserving legacy remote-code loading.

**Work in progress—not ready to merge.** Conversion passes exact weight checks, but the exported model is not yet a fully functional standalone HF checkpoint with `trust_remote_code=False`.

# Changelog

- Read native `text_config` and image-token fields while retaining the legacy `llm_config` path.
- Preserve shared MTP serialization in either HF config schema.
- Do not require remote modeling files for native-schema exports.
- Add a model-local, HF-5.19.0-guarded processor adapter: ignore the legacy derived video field in memory and omit the unused audio extractor for audio-free Super VL.
- Preserve the source checkpoint and installed Transformers code; do not apply global monkey patches.
- Add focused tests and document compatibility boundaries.
- Expand the supported Transformers range to `>=5.15,<5.20` and lock Transformers 5.19.0.
- Keep the full MiniMax M3 VL rotary correction only on 5.17.0. Use unpatched upstream geometry from HF #49164 on 5.18/5.19, accepting the native BF16/FP16 buffer-rounding precision difference. Document that policy and test native arithmetic without weakening the geometry checks.

# GitHub Actions CI

Local verification used `nvcr.io/nvidia/nemo:26.08.01` with an isolated Transformers 5.19.0 environment:

- 38 focused tests passed, including native/remote loader selection, native export reload with either trust flag, older-HF remote loading, and processor/conversion behavior.
- General-upgrade matrix before the final MiniMax policy adjustment: 2,868 focused tests passed per version on 5.17.0, 5.18.0, and 5.19.0 (three documented skips each); 52 MiniMax/CLIP checks passed each on 5.15.1 and 5.16.1; 158 PEFT 0.20 compatibility checks passed on 5.19.0. That matrix used the earlier extended precision workaround; focused MiniMax reruns validate the final unpatched-5.18/5.19 policy separately. These are focused tests, not all-model real-checkpoint parity or full functional CI.
- Native and remote-code HF → Megatron → HF roundtrips: **43,078/43,078 source weights exactly matched**, `atol=rtol=0`, TP1/PP2/EP2/ETP1 on four H100s. Independently saved HF exports have identical tensor keys/shapes/dtypes/bytes. A subsequent persisted Megatron readback comparison passed: **1,104 logical tensors byte-identical**, with no metadata or model-config differences.
- Processor artifact save/reload through Bridge preserved tensors and token IDs exactly for three image sizes and a synthetic rectangular two-frame video; chat template and source metadata hashes were preserved.
- A fresh standalone HF-only process, without the Bridge adapter and with `trust_remote_code=False`, **failed end-to-end validation**:
  - `AutoProcessor` still requires an absent audio feature extractor.
  - `AutoModelForImageTextToText` loaded, but reported four unexpected vision normalization/buffer keys.
  - Text forward with installed Mamba kernels produced non-finite logits. A controlled follow-up disabled only `mamba-ssm` within the HF interpreter; the PyTorch fallback produced finite logits. With that explicit runtime condition, source/export logits were bitwise identical on three prompts (cosine 1, max difference 0), and all 16-token greedy continuations matched. This is not an automatic Bridge production workaround or a shared-package uninstall.
  - Image inference was blocked by processor loading.
- With visual inputs prepared by the Bridge processor adapter, native HF source image forward/generation completed for square and rectangular images. Native video forward failed on the original source checkpoint: `torch.cat` receives a tensor-valued video `pooler_output`, rather than a sequence. Exported visual parity remains unverified. This visual test is not a standalone HF processor workflow.
- Standalone text-only checkpoint import/save/reload/export/inference verification is still running. No existing verification-card claims are changed.
- Final MiniMax policy rerun: **51 MiniMax tests passed on each of 5.15.1, 5.16.1, 5.17.0, 5.18.0, and 5.19.0** (255 total, no skips). Only 5.17.0 is patched; 5.18/5.19 retain native geometry and native rounded-buffer arithmetic.

# Before your PR is "Ready for review"

**Pre checks**:

- [x] Read and followed contributor guidelines.
- [x] Added focused tests.
- [x] Updated documentation.
- [x] Version-gated native imports and retained older-HF remote-code behavior.
- [ ] Resolve standalone processor loading without an audio extractor.
- [x] Isolate non-finite text logits to the installed Mamba path; verify source/export text inference with the explicit fallback.
- [ ] Resolve native vision-final LayerNorm naming compatibility for non-identity fine-tuned weights; Base identity affine values do not establish that support.
- [x] Fix native `hf_pretrained.model` accessor selection using `AutoModelForImageTextToText`; retain CausalLM for text and actual remote registrations, not merely the trust permission.
- [ ] Complete native HF inference/parity and CI validation before making ready.

# Additional Information

Scope is Nemotron 3.5 Super VL only, using `nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Super-VL-120B-A12B-Base-BF16` for verification. This is not a Nemotron Omni native-HF migration.

Independent reviews covered the complete diff and follow-up loader changes. Native HF-saved checkpoint key layouts and full standalone visual inference are not claimed supported by these original-checkpoint conversion tests. Remaining upstream/runtime limitations are explicit above.

@@ -2,6 +2,20 @@
 
 [MiniMax-M3](https://huggingface.co/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3) is a natively multimodal sparse MoE model from MiniMaxAI (428B total, ~23B active parameters). `MiniMaxM3Bridge` converts the vision tower, both multimodal projector stages, and sparse-MoE text backbone into a `MiniMaxM3VLModel`.
 
+## Transformers vision RoPE compatibility
+
+Bridge applies its full partial-3D vision RoPE correction only on Transformers
+5.17.0. Transformers 5.18+ includes the geometry fix from
+[HF PR #49164](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/49164), so Bridge
+leaves those versions unpatched.
+
+The native 5.18/5.19 implementation stores inverse frequencies in buffers.
+Explicit `.half()` or `.bfloat16()` casts can round these buffers, producing
+different results from the earlier FP32-per-forward calculation. Bridge accepts
+this precision difference and does not promise bitwise equality across these
+versions after dtype conversion. The three-axis geometry and partial rotation
+remain required and tested.
+
 {/* BEGIN GENERATED VERIFIED CONFIGURATIONS */}
 
 ## Verified configurations

@@ -12,6 +12,47 @@ The records below contain refreshed conversion, inference, and training verifica
 
 For language-only conversion and training without media components, see [the text-only companion guide](nemotron3.5-super-vl-text-only.md).
 
+## Native Hugging Face processor compatibility
+
+With Transformers 5.19.0, `AutoBridge.from_hf_pretrained(..., trust_remote_code=False)`
+uses a Bridge-local processor loading adapter for Super VL. It removes a legacy
+read-only video configuration field in memory and does not require an audio feature
+extractor for this audio-free model. The source checkpoint and installed Transformers
+code are not modified; image/video processing and token expansion use the native HF
+implementation. Remote-code loading remains available on older supported HF versions.
+
+The adapter is version-guarded to Transformers 5.19.0. Processor artifacts can be saved
+and reloaded through Bridge, but ordinary `AutoProcessor.from_pretrained` outside
+Bridge still encounters the native 5.19.0 audio-component requirement. This workaround
+does not imply standalone HF processor compatibility or full model forward parity.
+The wrapper's `hf_pretrained.model` accessor selects `AutoModelForImageTextToText`
+for native Super VL and retains `AutoModelForCausalLM` for legacy remote-code
+loading. Ordinary text checkpoints continue to use `AutoModelForCausalLM`.
+Filtered text-only conversion views are not directly loadable for HF inference;
+load their standalone text exports instead. Full native forward parity remains
+a separate verification requirement.
+
+Known native HF 5.19.0 runtime limitations for this checkpoint:
+
+- The installed `mamba-ssm` execution path produced non-finite text logits in
+  verification. With that package unavailable to the HF process, the native
+  PyTorch fallback produced bitwise-identical source/export logits and identical
+  16-token greedy continuations on three prompts. This is a diagnostic runtime
+  condition, not an automatic Bridge workaround; do not remove dependencies
+  from a shared Megatron training environment.
+- Image/video inputs can be prepared with the Bridge processor adapter and
+  passed to the native HF model. This is **not** standalone HF processor support.
+  Native video forward currently fails because it concatenates an already-tensor
+  `pooler_output` as though it were a sequence. Video inference is not verified.
+- Native HF does not consume the source checkpoint's
+  `vision_projector.vision_final_layernorm` keys. The tested Base checkpoint has
+  identity affine values, but this does not validate loading non-identity values
+  from a fine-tuned checkpoint. Bridge preserves these source weights during
+  conversion; native HF visual reload remains a separate compatibility gap.
+
+These limitations and checks do not update or supersede the historical
+verification-card results below.
+
 {/* BEGIN GENERATED VERIFIED CONFIGURATIONS */}
 
 ## Verified configurations

+    """Keep native processor compatibility separate from legacy remote-code loading."""
+
+    def _uses_remote_model(self) -> bool:
+        """Check the checkpoint registration, not only permission to execute it."""
+        return self.trust_remote_code and bool(
+            (getattr(self.config, "auto_map", None) or {}).get("AutoModelForCausalLM")
+        )
+
+    def _get_auto_model_class(self) -> type:
+        """Use native VL registration while retaining the remote CausalLM mapping."""
+        if self._text_only:
+            return super()._get_auto_model_class()
+        # Permission to execute remote code does not imply that the checkpoint
+        # uses it: native exports have no remote CausalLM registration.
+        if self._uses_remote_model():
+            return super()._get_auto_model_class()
+        if Version(transformers.__version__) < Version("5.19.0"):
+            raise ValueError("Native Super-VL requires Transformers >=5.19.0; use trust_remote_code=True otherwise.")
+        return AutoModelForImageTextToText
+
+    def _load_processor(self) -> ProcessorMixin | None:
+        if self.model_name_or_path is None or self._uses_remote_model():
+            return super()._load_processor()
+
+        version = Version(transformers.__version__)
+        if version < Version("5.19.0"):
+            raise ValueError("Native Super-VL requires Transformers >=5.19.0; use trust_remote_code=True otherwise.")
+
+        processor_cls = AutoProcessor
+        # Bound the workaround to the release whose loading behavior we tested.
+        # Future releases use their own loader and surface errors rather than
+        # silently dropping a required VLM artifact during conversion/export.

+"""Bridge-local loading adapter for Transformers 5.19.0's native VL processor.
+
+Imported lazily only by the version-guarded Super-VL pretrained wrapper. Image,
+video and text processing use the upstream implementation without monkey patches
+or changes to the source checkpoint. Loading these exports on unpatched HF 5.19.0
+still requires this Bridge adapter because HF insists on an audio extractor.
+"""
+
+import copy
+
+from transformers import AutoTokenizer
+from transformers.models.nemotron_h_omni.image_processing_nemotron_h_omni import (
+    NemotronH_Omni_Reasoning_V3ImageProcessor,
+)
+from transformers.models.nemotron_h_omni.processing_nemotron_h_omni import NemotronH_Omni_Reasoning_V3Processor
+from transformers.models.nemotron_h_omni.video_processing_nemotron_h_omni import (
+    NemotronH_Omni_Reasoning_V3VideoProcessor,
+)
+
+
+class Nemotron35VLProcessor(NemotronH_Omni_Reasoning_V3Processor):
+    """Reuse the native processor without requiring an unused audio component."""
+
+    @classmethod
+    def get_attributes(cls) -> list[str]:
+        # HF 5.19's ProcessorMixin binds constructor arguments to these modality
+        # attributes. The native constructor's trailing feature_extractor=None
+        # is deliberately not bound or serialized for this audio-free model.
+        return [name for name in super().get_attributes() if name != "feature_extractor"]

inline_comments.body:
[P2] Apply the native wrapper selection to config-only artifact export

**Failure:** This resolver is used by `from_hf_pretrained`, but the config-only branch of [`save_hf_pretrained`](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/1baae83ea016e726354529ce2294ee9478bfd0d2/src/megatron/bridge/models/conversion/auto_bridge.py#L1243-L1273) still constructs `PreTrainedCausalLM` directly. Consequently, `AutoBridge.from_auto_config(..., native_reference, trust_remote_code=False).save_hf_pretrained(...)` does not use `Nemotron35VLProcessor`. For an audio-free 5.19.0 source requiring this adapter, ordinary `AutoProcessor` fails on the missing audio extractor, and the base wrapper [silently returns `None`](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/1baae83ea016e726354529ce2294ee9478bfd0d2/src/megatron/bridge/models/hf_pretrained/causal_lm.py#L210-L224). Artifact saving therefore omits `processor_config.json` and processor/video settings instead of preserving the reloadable Bridge processor. Saving an image processor separately does not preserve those artifacts. The new roundtrip test exercises the specialized wrapper directly, so it misses this public export entrypoint.

**Correction:** In the non-text-only config-only artifact branch, use this resolver for causal-family wrappers. Preserve the existing artifact saver for non-causal heads rather than changing their artifact contracts. Suggested replacement for the direct construction at line 1266 (not executed; verify before adopting):

```python
artifact_cls = _resolve_pretrained_wrapper_cls(self.hf_pretrained)
if not issubclass(artifact_cls, PreTrainedCausalLM):
    artifact_cls = PreTrainedCausalLM
artifact_source = artifact_cls.from_pretrained(
    artifact_source_path, **artifact_kwargs
)
```

The invariant is that config-only native Super-VL exports use the same processor compatibility path as wrapper-backed exports, without materializing model weights.

**Preservation and acceptance:** Add proposed `test_super_vl_config_only_export_preserves_native_processor`, reusing the local [`processor_source` fixture](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/1baae83ea016e726354529ce2294ee9478bfd0d2/tests/unit_tests/models/nemotron_omni/test_native_processor.py#L141-L176) plus a native-schema config. Stub weight writing/postprocessing, export through a config-only bridge using both `hf_model_id` and `source_path`, and assert that `processor_config.json` exists, `video_temporal_patch_dim` remains 2, and Bridge reload reproduces the source image/video tensors and token IDs exactly. Retain the existing [config-only reference-artifact test](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/1baae83ea016e726354529ce2294ee9478bfd0d2/tests/unit_tests/models/test_auto_bridge.py#L1593-L1640) assertions that processor artifacts survive and reference weights are never loaded. Legacy Super-VL with a trusted remote registration must still delegate to the base processor loader and preserve remote modeling files; ordinary causal checkpoints must remain unchanged. Leave the separate text-only branch media-free, and retain the existing base artifact saver for masked/token-classification configurations.

One blocking correctness finding: config-only HF exports bypass the new processor adapter and can silently omit processor artifacts.

Reviewed all 15 changed files and directly affected loading/export paths. This was a static review; tests were not executed. The documented standalone HF inference limitations are not treated as verified conversion support.

No perf tests impacted.

- `test_super_vl_config_only_export_preserves_native_processor` — proposed regression covering both artifact-source options described inline.
- `test_native_processor_load_save_reload[False]` — retain exact image/video tensor and token-ID equality.
- `test_native_processor_load_save_reload[True]` — retain native reload when remote-code execution is permitted but not registered.
- `test_super_vl_native_export_does_not_require_remote_modeling_file`.
- `test_super_vl_native_config_preserves_language_and_image_settings`.
- `test_vision_rope_correction_is_version_gated_and_idempotent`.
